name: manifest-dev
description: Manifest-driven workflows: /define writes a verifiable Manifest, /do executes it, /ticket-up authors coherent Ticket units, /run-ticket recovers and lands one exact Ticket, and /sweep-tickets advances one Auto Ticket per scheduled invocation. /design-v2 is standalone experimental design guidance for HTML-first artifacts, with curated references, clean hierarchy and purposeful aliveness.
